title: Bounded HMI inspection request

excludeSystem.description: section=model: leave out SystemTags, HmiSystemTextLists and OpcUaAlarmTypes.

rowMode.description: compact: rows keep path, name, kind and contentSha256 without identity or attribute bodies; fetch a row in full for its identity.

modelRoots.description: Unified section=model only: HmiSoftware roots to walk, default all; walked in this canonical order.

includeScreenOwner.description: For an exact items request, include its native screen row and on-demand behavior metadata alongside item rows. Ordinary item enumeration excludes the screen owner.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 100; maxBytes still bounds a page (page.stoppedBy says which bound ended it).

$comment: Per-section rules, derived from OpennessSession.Hmi.cs (HmiInspect, HmiResolveNativeTarget, HmiCaptureClassic/Unified) and HmiInspectionRules.RequireTargetKind. They fail only requests the worker cannot answer with rows: a non-device section without an HMI selector (InvalidRequest), a selector kind outside the section (InvalidRequest), and items without screenPath (answered as a failed capture with an InvalidRequest diagnostic, not as an error). The worker applies the kind rule only when the selector's objectPath differs from its hmiPath, which a schema cannot compare; objectBelowDevice therefore matches only an objectPath that cannot be an hmiPath (an hmiPath ends in /hmi/<one escaped segment>), so a request the worker accepts never fails here, while some it refuses still pass. Fields a section does not read (the descriptions name the ones it reads) are ignored by the worker and stay valid. Every section reads schemaVersion, section, projectName, projectPath, rowMode, limit, offset, maxVisited, maxBytes and expectedMetadataRevision; the Host sets artifactDirectory.

then.description: section devices (also the default without section): lists every HMI device and takes no selector. A supplied target or identity is only checked as a stale guard (projectPath, projectCopyId, sessionGeneration); hmiPath, family, objectPath, screenPath, includeSource, includeScreenOwner, modelRoots and excludeSystem are not read.

section connections: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps the one row with that exact path; includeSource exports that object.

section tags: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps the one row with that exact path; includeSource exports that object.

section screens: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps the one row with that exact path; includeSource exports that object. Unified: an exact screen objectPath also reads that screen's behaviors.

section items: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). Needs screenPath (top level, else the selector's): the screen whose items are listed. includeScreenOwner adds the screen row. objectPath does not filter rows here; it only names the object includeSource exports.

section alarms: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps the one row with that exact path; includeSource exports that object.

section scripts: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps the one row with that exact path; includeSource exports that object.

section resources: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps the one row with that exact path; includeSource exports that object.

section model: Selects one HMI by target, else identity, else top-level hmiPath (with optional family, devicePath, targetProfile beside that hmiPath). Unified only. modelRoots and excludeSystem choose the roots; objectPath (top level, else the selector's) keeps that node and its subtree.

objectBelowDevice.description: A selector naming an object below the HMI device: its objectPath cannot equal an hmiPath, so its kind must belong to the requested section.

complete.description: True only when the capture is complete and no page is left (nextOffset null).

captureComplete.description: The capture finished without truncation or failure; says nothing about paging.

nextOffset.description: The paging signal: request this offset next; null on the last page.

compactRow.description: rowMode compact: no identity or attribute body; fetch the row in full for its identity.

description: Non-device sections require exact HMI selection in target, identity, or top-level hmiPath. Full returned identities add project/session stale guards; target selectors may contain only hmiPath. Limit/offset are bounded live observations, not immutable snapshot cursors; use project_model for cached pages. Classic screen inventory includes regular/template/popup/slide-in/global/overview roles with per-scope coverage. Additional Classic roles expose metadata, not qualified item parsers. Items require screenPath. includeSource requires exact objectPath and retained native artifact output. Scripts are only read as data. section=model is Unified-only typed public object-model readback: one hmiModelNode row per composition member with typed attributes and contentSha256 (the preservation manifest hash for that path); objectPath selects a subtree, script code is hashed and sensitive attribute names are excluded. Coverage and metadata revision do not imply complete native content.
